Users who rely on ChatGPT for quick image searches can now use a brand new gesture to add photos to conversations more quickly. Here's how it works in practice.

ChatGPT makes it easier to add recent photos to conversations

Although iOS's Visual Intelligence feature has been available for nearly two years, it currently only supports newer iPhone models and is not available in all regions.

For users who rely on ChatGPT for similar image searches, adding a photo in the past required tapping the "+", then tapping "Photos", and then selecting an image from the photo library.

Although the process is not exactly complicated, OpenAI has added a useful new gesture this week, allowing users to add recent photos to conversations more quickly.

OpenAI's Adam Fry said on X that users can now long-press the "+" button on the left side of the input box to bring up the four most recent photos.

Users can then choose a photo to add to the conversation, ask a question, or use the photo as part of the prompt content.

This new gesture is launched alongside several other updates ChatGPT rolled out this week, including more accurate recognition of the current time, faster loading and execution of long conversations on the web version, and clearer interface prompts when users are waiting for a network connection.

Would you use AI to search for images? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
